hint.pressKey: Point at a paragraph and press {key} to translate; press again to restore
hint.dwell: Hover over a paragraph briefly to translate it automatically

errors.notFound: Base URL or model not found (404){detail}
errors.microsoftNoToken: Microsoft Translate authentication failed: no token received
errors.resultCountMismatch: {service} returned a different number of results than requested
errors.emptyResult: The service returned an empty result
errors.aiSegmentMissing: The AI didn't return a translation for this paragraph
errors.segmentMissing: The translation service returned no result for this paragraph
errors.portDisconnected: Lost connection to the extension background. Please retry; if the extension just updated, refresh the page
errors.extensionUpdated: The extension was updated. Refresh the page and try again

serviceError.auth: The API key is invalid, or doesn't belong to the service at this base URL
serviceError.network: Couldn't reach the base URL. Check your network or the address
serviceError.timeout: Request timed out. Try again shortly
serviceError.rateLimit: Too many requests or quota exceeded. Try again shortly
serviceError.parse: The service returned an unrecognized response

page.partialFailed: Some paragraphs failed to translate: {message}. Click ↻ after a paragraph to retry, or switch engines in the DevGo popup.

hint.zhipu: GLM-4.5 and above think before answering by default, which slows full-page translation. For speed, pick glm-4-flash / glm-4-air
hint.codingPlan: Coding Plan keys only work with their dedicated base URLs; some plans restrict usage to coding tools — check your plan's terms
hint.arkCoding: Enter a model ID supported by your plan as the model name (open the model dropdown to fetch them). Coding Plan keys only work with their dedicated base URLs; some plans restrict usage to coding tools — check your plan's terms
hint.doubao: Enter the model ID or inference endpoint ID (ep-xxxx) from the Ark console as the model name
hint.ollama: Local services need no API key. Set the environment variable OLLAMA_ORIGINS=chrome-extension://* to allow the extension to connect

llmForm.modelPlaceholder: Pick or type a model name

models.fallbackCommon: , showing popular models below; you can also type your own
models.fallbackInput: , or type a model name directly
models.needBaseUrl: Enter the base URL to fetch the model list automatically
models.needApiKey: Enter the API key to see the full model list{fallback}
models.unsupported: This service doesn't support fetching the model list{fallback}

llmForm.baseUrlHint: Up to /v1 is enough; /chat/completions is appended automatically
llmForm.apiKey: API key (stored locally only, never in backups)
llmForm.assistantPrefilled: Prefilled from the AI translation config. The assistant needs a model with tool calling — switch to a stronger model such as a Coding Plan; takes effect after saving.
llmForm.promptHintAssistant: Appended to the end of the assistant's system prompt, e.g. "keep answers short" or "list the steps before acting"
llmForm.promptHintTranslate: Appended to the end of the system prompt, e.g. a glossary or tone: "technical-doc style; never translate Token"
llmForm.saveAndUse: Save and set as translation engine
llmForm.savedAndUsed: Saved and set as the current translation engine
llmForm.testFailedAuth: Connection failed: {reason}. If you just switched provider presets, make sure the key belongs to that service
